detail.longDescription:
Whether you're an app maker, or someone who loves exploring global App Store, Appboard makes it easy to find and track the apps you need.

- Discover popular apps from global charts.
- Track global rankings, ratings, and more of your favorite apps.
- Collect and bookmark the apps you’re interested in using folders.
- Easily understand app information in other languages with built-in translation.
- Quickly switch between different regional stores.
- Sync your data securely across all your devices with iCloud support.
- Use widgets to check app rankings, ratings, and more from your home screen.

Unlimited access to advanced features, including detailed app metrics, Pro widgets, and iCloud sync, requires a Pro subscription or in-app purchase.
